name: fix-brief
title: Fix investigation brief
for_each: select id,title from issues order by title

sections.title: Evidence and investigation notes
sections.sql: select actor,body,created_at from notes where issue_id=$1 order by created_at

sections.title: Captured events
sections.sql: select event_key,occurred_at,release,level from occurrences where issue_id=$1 order by occurred_at desc

name: release-review
title: Release error review
for_each: select id,version from releases order by deployed_at

sections.title: Issues observed on this release
sections.sql: select distinct s.title,s.status,s.owner,s.regressions from releases r join issues i on i.project_id=r.project_id and i.environment=r.environment join issue_summary s on s.id=i.id join occurrences o on o.issue_id=i.id and o.release=r.version where r.id=$1
